name: dws-excel
description: Read, analyze and edit local Excel and CSV files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xls, .csv). No Microsoft Office required. Sandboxed to folders you choose, with an optional read-only mode.

allowed_dir.title: Allowed folder
allowed_dir.description: Claude can only open spreadsheets inside this folder (and its subfolders). Defaults to your home folder.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide the write tools so Claude can read and analyze files but never change them.

max_file_mb.title: Max file size (MB)
max_file_mb.description: Files larger than this are refused, to keep memory use bounded.
